{{Character|name = Lifa|nationality = Unknown nationality|death = {{ne|1000}}|gender = Female|mentioned = {{amol|37}}|lastmentioned = {{amol|37}}|affiliation = The Shadow|occupation = Merchant|image = Wheel-icon.svg|status = Dead}}'''Lifa''' was a [[Darkfriend]] merchant running supplies for the [[Shadow]] from the [[Blasted Lands]] to the [[Field of Merrilor]] during the [[Last Battle]].

Her caravan was captured by [[Faile|Faile's]] group and Lifa and her three Darkfriend guards were presumably killed. They freed the captives and [[Aravine]] took over the caravan under the guise of Pansai, Lifa's "business partner".{{Ref/book|14|37}}

==Trivia==
*Lifa is named for Natasha Moana Lifa, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
